whitelisted evidence bytes or deterministic tool interface
scorer_store: T06 fixture JSON, regions, masks, and scorer-only extraction truth

subject_and_scorer_firewall.process_boundary: The subject adapter receives a serialized SubjectCasePackage created from an explicit whitelist. It receives no filesystem path, object reference, environment variable, database handle, archive handle, or import path capable of reaching scorer-only data.

deterministic_reference_subject.purpose: Harness, scorer, and projection conformance only; not a capability claim.
deterministic_reference_subject.behavior: For each case, return a precompiled structured response derived byte-for-byte from the frozen reference_response/reference_responses after validating the exact case hash and subject-visible projection. The running subject process cannot open the benchmark case source or scorer store.

execution_protocol.no_engine_adapter_in_initial_implementat: Inspect AI and provider/model adapters remain later bounded adapters; T07 first proves the project-owned reference engine and scorer.

criterion_scale.1: Partially correct but materially incomplete, imprecise, or weakly supported.
criterion_scale.2: Correct, sufficiently supported, and appropriately qualified.

scoring_protocol.not_evaluable_rule: A downstream criterion may be NOT_EVALUABLE_DUE_TO_UPSTREAM_FAILURE only when its frozen dependency makes independent scoring impossible; the case still remains in the denominator and any upstream hard failure/cap applies.

hard_failure_precedence.HF-1_CRITICAL: Immediate NO_GO_INVALID_RUN_OR_SUBJECT_RESULT; numeric score cannot override.
hard_failure_precedence.HF-2_MAJOR: Case failure and batch SCREENING_NO_GO; numeric score cannot override.
hard_failure_precedence.HF-3_MATERIAL: Case failure and SCREENING_REVIEW_REQUIRED; cannot be a screening pass.
hard_failure_precedence.HF-4_MINOR: Reported and retained; does not alone override thresholds unless case contract says so.

non_goals: No implementation or execution in this design turn.
No benchmark case, prompt, answer contract, reference response, rubric, split, or hash change.
No edit or replacement of the approved benchmark case file.
No model subject, provider adapter, model judge, OCR, VLM, or human-scoring workflow.
No benchmark execution, result publication, model selection, or public superiority claim.
No training, preference optimization, retrieval tuning, or use as a holdout.
No database migration or runtime-row creation.
No T04/T05/T06 or canonical archive modification.
No Inspect AI integration in the initial implementation.
No web UI, retrieval, embedding, cloud, Lambda, training, VS01-T08, or later work.

source_integrity: Verify the complete approved case file SHA-256 remains exact.
Verify every declared case_content_sha256 using PYTHON_SORTED_COMPACT_UTF8_V1.
Do not edit, normalize, or replace the approved case file.
execution_identity: Compute RFC 8785/SHA-256 for every case excluding only case_content_sha256.
Use execution_rfc8785_jcs_sha256 in T07 sample, case-result, and run identities.
Bind both the source-declared hash and execution JCS hash in every T07 authority record.
policy.future_authoring: Every newly authored or revised benchmark case must use RFC 8785 JCS directly. This compatibility rule applies only to the exact approved BENCH-VS01-BATCH-01 bytes.
